reader_summary.headline: Today, we’re breaking down Novocure, a global oncology company that has pioneered a new approach to cancer treatment.
reader_summary.overview: Today, we’re breaking down Novocure, a global oncology company that has pioneered a new approach to cancer treatment. For over 100 years, the tools used to fight cancer have largely remained unchanged. To explain the state of cancer research and how the business has developed over the past twenty years, I’m joined by Bill Doyle – Novocure’s Executive Chairman.
